translations.web: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’ ”
translations.bsb: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
translations.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
